'''Torge Gommer''' was a [[human]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]], flying in [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] as [[Green Two]]. Based out of the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]], Gommer was among the [[Alliance Military|forces]] scrambled for the [[Battle of Scarif]], in which the [[pilot]] engaged [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Scarif fleet|forces]] above the [[planet]] [[Scarif]] in [[1 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Attention, all flight personnel, please report to your commanders immediately. All flight personnel, please report to your commanders immediately. We have been redirected to Scarif. Pilots, you'll be briefed by your squadron leaders en route. May the Force be with you.|An announcement in the Great Temple scrambles Green Squadron and other rebel pilots|audio=ScarifAnnouncement-RO.flac|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:TorgeGommer-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|Gorge Tommer flew for the Alliance as Green Two.]]
The [[human]]<ref name="Rogue One" /> Torge Gommer served as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during its [[Galactic Civil War|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. Gommer used the [[callsign]] [[Green Two]] as part of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]], an [[X-wing starfighter]] [[squadron]] within the [[Massassi Group]] of rebels that were based in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWROUVG" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Gommer walked passed the rebels [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] in one of the Great Temple's [[hangar]]s shortly after the [[Alliance Cabinet]] chose not to launch an attempt to steal the plans for the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. Cassian and Erso chose to ignore the cabinet's decision and left for Scarif soon after with their own [[Rogue One|team]] of volunteers. When reports got back to the Massassi Group that there were rebels on Scarif, the [[Alliance Military|rebel forces]] on Yavin were scrambled to travel to Scarif and provide support in stealing the plans.<ref name="Rogue One" />

As an announcement about Scarif blared through the speakers of the Great Temple, Gommer ran with a group of other [[pilot]]s into one of the structure's [[hangar]]s and mounted a [[Rebel personnel carrier|personnel carrier]] that then carried Green Two and other pilots through the room. Once in their vehicles, Green Squadron traveled with an [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance fleet]] commanded by [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] through [[hyperspace]] to the [[Scarif system]] where upon arriving,<ref name="Rogue One" /> Green Squadron engaged [[Scarif fleet|Imperial forces]] above the planet<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]]. The Alliance ultimately managed to succeed in stealing the plans and escaping, but not without heavy casualties.<ref name="Rogue One" /> A total of fifteen Alliance [[starfighter]]s were destroyed, mostly from Red or Blue Squadrons.<ref name="Grounded">{{StoryCite|story=Grounded|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:TorgeGommerHelmet-SW100Objects.png|thumb|right|200px|Torge Gommer's flight helmet]]
Torge Gommer had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Equipment==
Torge Gommer wore an orange [[flight suit]] with a white [[flak vest]], a gray [[flight harness]], gray [[glove]]s, and a gray [[Novaldex]] [[Diagnostech life support unit]]. The pilot's [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] had dark gray sides, white raised areas, and a red section above the visor. The [[helmet]] had a red symbol on each side panel and a gray circle with a jagged red bolt through it above each side of the visor.<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torge Gommer appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Rogue One" /> and was identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and named the character via a caption of the helmet<ref name="SWROUVG" /> Gommer wears in the film.<ref name="Rogue One" />
